source.basis: Operator facility page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

address: 11155 Red Run Blvd., Suite 200, Owings Mills, MD 21117

reading.body:
Expedient Tidepoint publishes 2.3 MW of IT capacity across 22,000 square feet of technical space. At 10 kW per rack, a common colocation density, that load supports roughly 230 racks; at 40 kW per rack, a density more typical of GPU training clusters, the same 2.3 MW supports roughly 57 racks. Those are assumptions about rack density, not the operator's claims. The arithmetic shows a facility sized for enterprise workloads rather than large-scale AI training.

The three certifications on the spec page describe what the facility is qualified to host. PCI DSS qualifies it for environments that process payment card data. HIPAA qualifies it for environments handling protected health information. HITRUST qualifies it for a broader information risk management framework used heavily in healthcare and financial services. No tenants are named on the published page.

Among the eleven data center facilities mapped in Maryland, this site holds the top rank by published IT capacity, but that ranking reflects a narrow sample. Only two of those eleven facilities publish a megawatt figure at all, and together they total 4.6 MW, meaning Tidepoint accounts for exactly half of that published total. The state context does not tell us the capacity of the nine facilities with no published figure, so the ranking says more about disclosure gaps than about Maryland's true data center footprint. For an AI workload that needs scale, 2.3 MW is a starting point, not a destination.
